title: Modular Evidence Packs & Pay-Per-Section Attestation Pricing Pilot
creator: Maya Lin
description:
Problem: Enterprise customers frequently request only a subset of SIG/CAIQ evidence (e.g., networking, encryption, and access controls) rather than full attestation bundles. Current monolithic attestation bundles increase friction and procurement time and often cause unnecessary legal review effort.

Opportunity: Ship a pilot that lets customers request modular evidence packs (by questionnaire section) and enables a pay-per-section pricing model with bundled discounts. Complement with a lightweight authoring workflow so Redwood security can create 'signed attestation snippets' that are reusable across customers. This reduces evidence duplication, shortens sales cycles, and surfaces a new incremental revenue stream for high-touch attestation work.

Scope: Pilot with 8 sales-qualified enterprise accounts; focus on SIG/CAIQ and ISO-lite checklist sections. Deliverables: (1) attestation pack spec and UI in Console for customers to select sections, (2) backend pack composition service to produce downloadable, signed evidence snippets with audit metadata, (3) pricing experiment configuration and billing metrics, (4) basic self-serve redaction request workflow for customers to propose redactions to snippets, (5) analytics dashboard to measure time-to-purchase, evidence request frequency, and legal review minutes avoided.
acceptance_criteria: Console: customers can pick 1..N attestation sections and request a single 'modular pack' download
Backend: system composes pack as a zipped bundle containing signed snippet files and an audit manifest with timestamp and signer ID
Billing: selected sections map to pricing units and pilot billing logs show per-section charges and any applied bundle discounts
Authoring: Security SMEs can create and version signed snippets in a simple authoring UI (or CLI) and mark snippets as reusable
Redaction workflow: customers can submit a redaction request that creates a tracked ticket and flags the evidence bundle as 'pending redaction' in the audit manifest
Metrics: dashboard surfaces key metrics - requests per customer, average sections per pack, median time from request to delivery, and legal review minutes avoided (self-reported by AE)
Security: all signed snippets pass a minimal integrity check and signatures are verifiable via our KMS public key; export includes tamper-evidence headers
tasks: Write PRD and experiment hypothesis with target KPIs
Design Console selection UX for modular packs
Implement compose service and signed snippet format
Add billing mapping and experiment toggle in pricing service
Build simple snippet authoring UI for security team
Instrument analytics dashboard and pilot tracking metrics
Run legal/security review and finalize redaction SLA
Coordinate pilot outreach with AE and Solutions teams
notes_or_discussion: 2026-02-25 kickoff: Security requested ability to reuse commonly asked evidence to reduce duplicate work

Trade-offs: fully templated attestations reduce effort but increase risk of over-sharing; we will limit default snippets to non-sensitive descriptive evidence and require manual review for architecture diagrams
Pricing hypothesis: per-section price with 30% discount if >4 sections yields higher conversion for mid-size customers; target ARR uplift of $120k over 6 months from pilot cohort
Redaction policy: customers can request redaction; security must respond within 10 business days during pilot
Decision: sign snippets with KMS RSA key; store audit manifest in customer project bucket with immutability flag
Follow-ups: implement telemetry to detect repeated redaction requests for the same snippet (signals snippet needs rewrite)
Risk: some enterprises require signed, timestamped answers anchored to contract; escalate to Legal if asked for contract-level attestation
